name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Self-diagnostic build. Measure Orbit touch time, calendar start/draw/completion times, first/second 5wCal touch timing, exact selection stage, requested buzz duration, stored day offset, return callback, applied offset, and LCD-off clearing. Show timing/status directly on-screen (C/D/S for calendar timing; Sxx/xx or E:stage with dt and B120/B500 for selection; SOK/E and applied offset on Orbit) and persist the same facts in orbclo_orbitdev.diag.json.
